title: Same Answer, New Box: How Much of RLVR's Out-of-Domain Gain Is Answer Format?
abstract: arXiv:2610.20639v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is credited with gains beyond the domain its rewards check, such as higher MMLU accuracy after training on mathematics. Such accuracies are usually read out of the model's text by an answer extractor. A model that learns to write its answer where the extractor looks can therefore score higher without answering better. We measure how much of the gain reported by extractors copied from public code arises this way. We generate outputs from a base model and its RL model and score them twice: with those extractors, and with one extractor of our own that reads a stated answer whether it is in the answer box \boxed{} or in the text. On four released 7B SimpleRL base-RL pairs, 82% of the out-of-domain multiple-choice gain that these extractors report disappears under ours: it is a gain in answer format, not in answers. translated_title: 相同的答案，新的框：RLVR的域外增益中有多少来自答案格式？
translated_abstract: 带有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）被认为能带来超越其奖励所检验领域的增益，例如在数学上训练后MMLU准确率更高。这些准确率通常是通过答案提取器从模型文本中读取的。因此，一个学会把答案写在提取器寻找位置的模型，即使回答得并没有更好，也能获得更高的分数。我们测量了从公开代码中复制的提取器所报告的增益中有多少是这样产生的。我们生成基础模型及其RL模型的输出，并进行两次评分：一次使用这些提取器，另一次使用我们自己的提取器——无论答案是写在答案框\boxed{}中还是文本中，都能读取所陈述的答案。在四个已发布的7B SimpleRL基础-RL模型对上，这些提取器报告的域外多项选择增益中有82%在我们的提取器下消失了：这是答案格式上的增益，而非答案本身的增益。基础模型已经在文本中陈述了它们的大部分答案，而RL使……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 研究发现，RLVR所报告的域外多项选择基准提升中约82%只是答案格式提取带来的假象，而非模型真正回答能力的提升。
en_tdlr: About 82% of RLVR's reported out-of-domain multiple-choice gains disappear when using a format-agnostic answer extractor, revealing that much of the improvement is a gain in answer format rather than in actual answers.
